summary: The exact PR revision built and launched successfully in an iPhone 17 Pro simulator, but interactive validation of the changed delegation-result flow could not be completed because cua-driver lacks macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording grants.

review.ci: All checks passed except the initial Measure (build + test) run, whose unrelated GatewayTransportLeak test failed once; a failed-job rerun was in progress when validation became blocked on CUA permissions.

scenario_steps: Resolved and pinned PR #514 to the exact head SHA before review or execution.
Reviewed the five-file diff and ran the focused parser regression suite.
Moved PR #514 and issue #510 from state:review to state:validation.
Built the macOS app and the iOS simulator app from the pinned revision.
Installed and launched Portal-iOS on an iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
Attempted multiple cua-driver captures against Portal and Simulator; every capture returned a 0x0 frame.
Ran hermes computer-use doctor, which confirmed missing Accessibility and Screen Recording grants for com.trycua.driver.
Stopped without claiming the changed flow passed; lifecycle is returned to state:blocked.

screenshots.observed_result: Portal-iOS launched and displayed its Connect to your harness screen without a crash or system error. This screenshot proves launch only; it does not prove the delegation-result rendering flow.

blocker.diagnostic: Accessibility is NOT granted; Screen Recording is NOT granted; AX capability is not trusted.
blocker.required_operator_action: Grant Accessibility and Screen Recording to CuaDriver.app (bundle com.trycua.driver) in System Settings, restart cua-driver, then rerun this validation task.
